Exploitability_explanation: Rollup is a build tool (devDependency). Vulnerabilities in build tools are not reachable in the production runtime of the client-side library. Probability 0.01.
Rollup is used only during the build process. No active code path exists in the library itself. Probability 0.01.

form-data is a transitive dependency of jsdom, which is used only in the test environment (devDependency). It is not present in the runtime dependencies or reachable by users of MirageJS. Probability 0.01.
Babel is a development tool. No named capturing groups were found in the codebase's regular expressions, which is a prerequisite for this ReDoS vulnerability in the generated code. Probability 0.01.
Babel runtime helper functions for named capturing groups are not triggered as the codebase does not use named capturing groups in regular expressions. Probability 0.01.
Micromatch is used by development tools like ESLint and Rollup. It is not used in the runtime library. Probability 0.01.
cross-spawn is a development utility used by ESLint and other tools. It is not reachable in the production code. Probability 0.01.
cross-spawn is not a runtime dependency. It is used by dev tools (ESLint, npm-run-all). No code path exists in the library for exploitation. Probability 0.01.
